definitions.gloss: test kit; testing kit (typically for medical or home diagnostic testing)
definitions.explanation: A packaged set of tools and reagents for carrying out a specific test, especially medical tests done at home or on-site. Became widely familiar to the general public during the COVID-19 pandemic, when self-administered antigen test kits ({抗原|こうげん}{検査|けんさ}キット) were sold over the counter.

examples.japanese: {検査|けんさ}キットを{買|か}った。
{薬局|やっきょく}で{抗原|こうげん}{検査|けんさ}キットを{販売|はんばい}している。
examples.english: Antigen test kits are sold at pharmacies.

examples.japanese: {発熱|はつねつ}したので、{自宅|じたく}で{検査|けんさ}キットを{使|つか}って{結果|けっか}を{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: Since I had a fever, I used a test kit at home to check the result.

notes:
Compound of {検査|けんさ} ('test, examination, inspection') + キット (from English 'kit'). Most commonly refers to medical self-test kits: antigen/PCR tests for infectious diseases, pregnancy tests, DNA tests, allergy tests, and the like. Can also refer to industrial or environmental test kits (water quality, soil testing, etc.).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {抗原|こうげん}{検査|けんさ}キット: antigen test kit
- PCR{検査|けんさ}キット: PCR test kit
- {妊娠|にんしん}{検査|けんさ}キット: pregnancy test kit
- {検査|けんさ}キットを{使|つか}う: to use a test kit
- {検査|けんさ}キットで{調|しら}べる: to check with a test kit
- {検査|けんさ}キットが{陽性|ようせい}/{陰性|いんせい}: the test kit is positive/negative

RELATED WORDS:
- {検査|けんさ}: test, examination, inspection — the general term
- {抗原|こうげん}{検査|けんさ}: antigen test
- {陽性|ようせい}: positive (test result)
- {陰性|いんせい}: negative (test result)
- {自己|じこ}{検査|けんさ}: self-testing
